pages.title: Dynasty Pressure Potion
pages.text: Brew an Echo Shard into Awkward Potions. Drinking the result raises Dynasty Threat, causing stronger royal shields and affixes to appear sooner.

pages.title: Fission Wraith Heart
pages.text: Make a Warden's sonic boom deal the killing blow to a Wither. The heart drops at 100% by default; the common config can change this.$(br2)On its first toss or pickup, the heart binds to that player and cannot be taken by anyone else.

pages.title: Crystal Extraction
pages.text: After defeating the vanilla Ender Dragon and reaching the relevant Curse VII step, keep at least ten vanilla End Crystals alive on the central island.$(br2)Drop your bound heart there. The crystals focus for 15 seconds. Removing the heart, losing crystals, or leaving the valid area cancels the rite.

pages.title: Dragon-Breath Infusion
pages.text: After defeating the vanilla dragon, leave at least one vanilla End Crystal alive on the central island. Drop an Eternal Silence Compound Bow beside one Dragon's Breath.$(br2)After 30 seconds of crystal focus, the bow transforms permanently. Removing an offering or all crystals cancels the rite.

pages.title: Curse Rite Index
pages.text: The Curse I cauldron offerings, Curse VI final exchange, and all nine reversal paths are recorded in Nine Reversal Records. Exact configurable quantities follow the common config.$(br2)Apep's revival and the Silent Court gateway are in Courts & Expeditions.
